output.reason: The brief is convincing. Serial-matched claim rates are the same across installer groups and firmware versions, while Durrant-Hale valves stay low in every group. That evidence, plus the bench leak tests, the out-of-service test rig and the recycled certificate values, rules out the installer and firmware explanations and shows the certificates are likely fake. It also sets out clear steps, including holding the six lots and sourcing more from Durrant-Hale to cover the line impact.
